name: Cast-iron owl doorstop
description: A heavy cast-iron owl that props the stockroom's alley door open on delivery days. Priya trips over it often enough to know exactly where it lives.

name: Elias's 1994 notebook
description: One exercise book among forty: the 1994 volume, labelled in Elias's careful hand. The year Thomas Hobbs died and the bill of sale surfaced.

name: Framed bill of sale
description: The bill of sale for Hobbs Cafe, dated a month before Thomas Hobbs died, hanging framed in Marcus's study.

name: Grey wool overcoat
description: Marcus's long grey overcoat, worn to the fair against the November cold. Half the village would know that squared-off walk anywhere.

name: Hand-painted lantern
description: A hand-built lantern painted with sweet peas, wrapped in a delivery blanket. Something small is taped inside the little door.

name: Ceremony programme
description: The fair's ceremony programme, annotated in Elias's hand. Under the nine o'clock reading he has written a title of his own.

name: Archive boxes
description: Elias Grant's donation to the new village archive: forty years of exercise books boxed by year, waiting for shelves in the bookshop stockroom.
